purpose: Short source-based English paraphrases where the cached first sentence is long, unclear, malformed, or misses an important distinction. These describe IFC concepts, not measured database contents.

common.IfcAirTerminalBox: An HVAC device that regulates the amount of air supplied to downstream ductwork.
common.IfcAlarm: A device that signals an abnormal condition or activates an alarm signal.
common.IfcAlignment: Defines a reference system for linear positioning and the geometric layout of linear infrastructure, including horizontal, vertical, and cant layouts.
common.IfcAlignmentSegment: A portion of an alignment with a defined mathematical description of its horizontal direction, vertical direction, or railway cant.
common.IfcAnnotation: A graphical annotation that adds notes or meaning to objects within the project's geometric and spatial context.
common.IfcAsset: An identifiable group of elements treated as one asset with financial value.
common.IfcBeam: An individual beam, usually horizontal or nearly horizontal. It is not necessarily load bearing.
common.IfcBearing: A support component that transfers loads between structural parts while usually allowing specified displacement or rotation.
common.IfcBoiler: A pressure-rated vessel that heats water or another fluid using an energy source.
common.IfcBorehole: A linear geological or geotechnical model that may assemble strata, capping, lining, and related elements.
common.IfcBridge: A civil structure providing passage above obstacles or between elevated points for people, animals, vehicles, or services.
common.IfcBuilding: A structure intended to shelter occupants or contents and normally remain permanently in one place.
common.IfcBuildingElementProxy: An element represented without a more specific predefined semantic class for the element it represents.
common.IfcCaissonFoundation: A foundation formed as an open or closed hollow box.
common.IfcChiller: A refrigeration device that removes heat from a liquid using a vapor-compression or absorption cycle.
common.IfcCondenser: A heat-rejection device that typically condenses a substance from gas to liquid.
common.IfcConstructionResource: A general construction resource, including labor, materials, equipment, products, subcontractors, or resource groups such as crews.
common.IfcConveyorSegment: A continuous conveyor run connecting sections of a conveyor system, using a carrying mechanism such as a belt, chain, or screw.
common.IfcCooledBeam: A chilled-beam device that cools room air by circulating fluid through exposed finned tubes above a space.
common.IfcCoolingTower: A device that rejects heat to ambient air by circulating and partially evaporating a fluid.
common.IfcCostItem: A cost or financial value with contextual information, used as an item within a cost schedule.
common.IfcCostSchedule: A collection of cost items for an estimate, bill of quantities, work order, or another cost-related presentation.
common.IfcCourse: A long, relatively thin layer of material laid on site over another horizontal or nearly horizontal built element.
common.IfcCovering: A finishing or protective covering applied to a surface or element, such as flooring, ceiling, cladding, insulation, or roofing.
common.IfcCurtainWall: A wall assembly hung from the floor or roof structure rather than supported directly on a floor.
common.IfcDistributionBoard: A flow controller that groups electrical or communications devices at one location for a particular purpose.
common.IfcDoorStandardCase: A door with additional constraints on operation, opening direction, frame and lining parameters, and geometric representation.
common.IfcDuctFitting: A junction or transition connecting duct segments and changing flow characteristics such as direction or flow rate.
common.IfcDuctSilencer: A device installed in ductwork to reduce noise from airflow or equipment in adjacent spaces or downstream ducts.
common.IfcEarthworksElement: An element created by earthworks to form subgrade, raise ground levels, or reinforce or stabilize soil.
common.IfcElementComponent: A minor component included in, added to, or connecting larger elements.
common.IfcEnergyConversionDevice: A device within a distribution system that converts energy or transfers heat.
common.IfcEquipmentElement: A premanufactured movable item of equipment that provides a building service or another servicing function.
common.IfcFacility: A built facility, such as a building, bridge, railway, road, or marine facility.
common.IfcFeatureElementAddition: An existence-dependent feature that adds to or otherwise modifies the shape and appearance of a host element.
common.IfcFeatureElementSubtraction: An existence-dependent feature that subtracts from or otherwise modifies the shape and appearance of a host element.
common.IfcFlowController: An element that regulates flow through a distribution system, such as a damper, valve, switch, or relay.
common.IfcFlowInstrument: An instrument displaying a system property at a point or the difference in that property between two points.
common.IfcFlowMovingDevice: A device that moves or circulates a liquid or gas through a distribution system, such as a pump or fan.
common.IfcFlowStorageDevice: A device used for temporary storage within a distribution system, such as a tank.
common.IfcFlowTerminal: A permanently attached endpoint or starting point of a distribution system, such as an air outlet, drain, or sink.
common.IfcFlowTreatmentDevice: A distribution-system device that removes unwanted material from a liquid or gas.
common.IfcGeotechnicalStratum: A discrete, approximately homogeneous geological feature represented as a solid, a top surface, or voxels.
common.IfcGrid: A planar design grid positioned in three-dimensional space to locate structural and other design elements.
common.IfcGroup: An arbitrary grouping of objects for a shared purpose or organizational context.
common.IfcInterceptor: A gravity drainage device that retains unwanted or hazardous matter while allowing sewage or other liquids to discharge.
common.IfcLightFixture: A housing for one or more lamps, optionally including devices that control or modify their light output.
common.IfcLiquidTerminal: An endpoint or starting point where a liquid distribution system exchanges liquid with its external environment.
common.IfcMarineFacility: A major facility in the ports and waterways domain, such as a quay, jetty, shipyard, or breakwater.
common.IfcMechanicalFastener: A component that mechanically joins building elements or their parts.
common.IfcMooringDevice: An active or passive component used to secure a vessel, such as a bollard or quick-release hook.
common.IfcMove: An activity relocating people, organizational groups, or organizations together with their furniture and equipment.
common.IfcNavigationElement: An active or passive component providing navigational instructions or warnings to vessels, such as a buoy or beacon.
common.IfcObjectDefinition: A general semantic definition of an object or process, including object occurrences and object types.
common.IfcOccupant: An actor identifying the form of occupancy of a property.
common.IfcOpeningStandardCase: An opening with additional constraints on dimensions, position within its host element, and geometric representation.
common.IfcPavement: A road or paved-area element providing an even load-carrying surface for vehicles or pedestrians, usually composed of several courses.
common.IfcPile: A slender foundation member embedded into the ground to support a load.
common.IfcPipeFitting: A junction or transition connecting pipe segments and changing flow characteristics such as direction or flow rate.
common.IfcProcess: An activity or event occurring in time, with possible sequence and input/output relationships to other processes.
common.IfcProtectiveDeviceTrippingUnit: A device that triggers a separate circuit-breaking unit when current exceeds a specified level.
common.IfcProxy: A generic container for an object described by associated properties, with optional geometric representation and spatial placement.
common.IfcRailing: A frame assembly beside circulation spaces or boundaries, used in place of or together with walls.
common.IfcRamp: An inclined passage linking levels at different elevations.
common.IfcRampFlight: A single inclined ramp segment connecting landings, floors, or slabs at different elevations.
common.IfcReinforcingElement: A component embedded in concrete so that it acts together with the concrete to resist forces.
common.IfcReinforcingMesh: A welded grid of longitudinal and transverse wires or bars, commonly used to reinforce concrete slabs.
common.IfcRoof: The top covering of a building, protecting it from weather.
common.IfcSanitaryTerminal: A fixed water-related appliance or terminal for drinking, cleaning, or foul-water disposal, including equipment directly serving it.
common.IfcScheduleTimeControl: Time-related process information, including actual or scheduled start and finish times, duration, and float.
common.IfcSensor: A device that measures a physical quantity and converts the measurement into a readable signal.
common.IfcShadingDevice: A purpose-built device that limits sunlight, natural light, or visibility.
common.IfcSpaceHeater: A device that heats a limited space through radiation or natural convection using electricity, steam, or hot water.
common.IfcStackTerminal: A terminal at the top of a ventilating stack or rainwater pipe, providing protection or collecting discharge from guttering.
common.IfcStructuralActivity: A structural action or reaction, such as a load, displacement, support reaction, internal force, or deflection.
common.IfcStructuralCurveConnection: A linear structural-analysis connection or support where surface members meet along an edge.
common.IfcStructuralCurveMember: A linear structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a beam, column, or rod.
common.IfcStructuralSurfaceConnection: A surface structural-analysis connection or support where members meet over a face.
common.IfcStructuralSurfaceMember: A surface structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a slab, wall, or shell.
common.IfcSystem: A collection of related parts organized to perform a common function or provide a service.
common.IfcTendon: A tensioned steel wire, cable, bar, rod, or strand used to prestress concrete.
common.IfcTubeBundle: An assembly of tubes used for heat transfer within equipment such as a chiller or coil.
common.IfcWasteTerminal: A device that collects or intercepts waste from sanitary terminals or other equipment and discharges it into a drainage system.
common.IfcWindowStandardCase: A window with additional constraints on operation, opening direction, frame, lining, construction type, and geometric representation.

IFC2X3.IfcColumn: A usually vertical structural member that transfers forces to its base, primarily through compression.
IFC2X3.IfcCurtainWall: A non-load-bearing exterior wall that encloses a building.
IFC2X3.IfcFlowSegment: A typically straight, continuous, two-port section of a distribution system, such as a pipe or duct section.
IFC2X3.IfcProcess: An activity in construction, design, costing, procurement, maintenance, or a related process.
IFC2X3.IfcStructuralItem: An abstract structural-analysis item covering structural members and structural connections and their associations with structural actions.

IFC4.IfcColumn: A vertical structural member, often located at an intersection of the structural grid.
IFC4.IfcCurtainWall: An exterior wall assembly hung from the floor or roof structure rather than supported directly on a floor.

IFC4X3_ADD2.IfcAnnotation: An information element that adds notes or meaning to objects within the project's geometric and spatial context.
IFC4X3_ADD2.IfcColumn: A vertical structural or architectural member, often located at an intersection of the structural grid.
IFC4X3_ADD2.IfcRailing: A frame assembly beside pedestrian or vehicle circulation spaces or boundaries, used in place of or together with walls.

IFC2X3.IfcBeam.note: The full buildingSMART definition states that the beam need not be load bearing; the bundled opening paragraph only contains the ISO definition.

IFC2X3.IfcStructuralItem.note: The bundled description contains only a malformed heading. The replacement uses the official entity definition, not another IFC version's definition.

IFC4X3_ADD2.IfcAlignment.note: The opening sentence refers to three concepts without defining them. The replacement uses the official definition's linear positioning and infrastructure layout explanation.
